editorial.blurb: Han 202 is a hidden gem in Bridgeport offering an inventive Chinese-French fusion tasting menu in an intimate, elegantly minimalist setting where every course is expertly timed and executed.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or call ahead—this tiny, hard-to-spot restaurant fills up quickly and has very limited seating; ask your server about supplemental charges on certain prix fixe items before ordering.
